title: Battle of Peschiera
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Peschiera", at revision 1370585888, opens: "The Battle of Peschiera was a minor clash that occurred on 6 August, 1796 between the Austrian troops of General Anton Lipthay and the French division of General André Masséna." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2984845, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1796 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
